tips.zh_TW: 在黃色邊框圈成的行動區內有個懸浮球,可以從那裡叫出各種功能選單。
tips.en: There's a hover ball inside the yellow-bordered action area — it opens all sorts of menus.

tips.zh_TW: 在我身上按右鍵會跳出選單,裡面藏著好多平常看不到的小功能。
tips.en: Right-click me to bring up a menu — it hides a bunch of little features you don't normally see.

tips.zh_TW: 有些功能只收錄在桌面工具匣的迷你圖示裡,對它點右鍵研究看看吧?
tips.en: Some features only live in the tiny system tray icon — try right-clicking it and see what's there.

tips.zh_TW: 收合起來的小圖示,滑鼠移過去會自動放大一下,提醒你這裡點得到。
tips.en: Collapsed little icons grow a bit when your mouse hovers over them, just to remind you they're clickable.

tips.zh_TW: 行動區被拖到螢幕外回不來的話,系統匣有「行動區重設」。
tips.en: If the action area gets dragged off-screen and won't come back, the tray menu has "Reset Activity Area".

tips.zh_TW: 浮動視窗跑到螢幕外找不到了?系統匣的「浮動視窗重設」能叫回來。
tips.en: Lost a floating window off-screen? "Reset Floating Windows" in the tray menu brings it back.

tips.zh_TW: 對懸浮球按右鍵可以讓滑鼠暫時穿透這層視窗。
tips.en: Right-clicking the hover ball lets your mouse temporarily click through this window.

tips.zh_TW: 行動區邊框可以從桌面工具匣的圖示那邊隱藏,就不容易誤觸了。
tips.en: You can hide the action area's border from the tray icon, so it's harder to click by accident.

tips.zh_TW: 從懸浮球裡的道具欄,可以把道具拿出來給我們玩。
tips.en: From the Prop Tray in the hover ball, you can take out props for us to play with.

tips.zh_TW: 道具散落一地的話,用「清掃桌面道具」功能就能清乾淨。
tips.en: Props scattered everywhere? "Clear Props from Desktop" tidies them all up.

tips.zh_TW: 要關掉程式的話,用系統匣的「完全退出」,才存得到最新狀態。
tips.en: To close the app, use "Quit Completely" in the tray menu so the latest state gets saved.

tips.zh_TW: 如果想將指定的桌寵退場,你需要去桌面工具匣操作。
tips.en: To make a specific pet leave, you need to do that from the system tray.

tips.zh_TW: 可以在全局設定讓程式跟著電腦開機一起啟動。
tips.en: Global Settings can make the app start up together with your computer.

tips.zh_TW: 介面配色其實是可以換的!也有好幾種字型可以挑。
tips.en: The interface colors can actually be changed! There are several fonts to pick from, too.

tips.zh_TW: 版本更新的檢查要自己從工具匣手動執行,你今天檢查版本了嗎?
tips.en: Update checks have to be run manually from the tray — have you checked for updates today?

tips.zh_TW: 自動檢查只會偶爾看看有沒有重要更新,平常記得自己手動檢查喔。
tips.en: Automatic checks only look for important updates once in a while — remember to check manually now and then.

tips.zh_TW: 即使沒有網路,遊戲安裝包裡其實也帶了對應版本的積木編輯器html!
tips.en: Even without internet, the installer actually bundles a matching version of the block editor html!

tips.zh_TW: 除了右鍵選單的各種「移動模式」,也可以試試工具匣的「全體行為」喔。
tips.en: Besides the movement modes in the right-click menu, try "All Pets' Behavior" in the tray too.

tips.zh_TW: 如果不想我們追著你的滑鼠跑,可以從右鍵選單「停止跟著我」。
tips.en: If you don't want us chasing your mouse, choose "Stop following me" in the right-click menu.

tips.zh_TW: 拿不定主意嗎?右鍵選單的「幫我決定…」可以幫你抽籤。
tips.en: Can't make up your mind? "Help me decide…" in the right-click menu draws lots for you.

tips.zh_TW: 右鍵選單的「幫我占卜…」裡有運勢籤跟塔羅牌可以用。
tips.en: "Tell my fortune…" in the right-click menu has fortune sticks and tarot cards.

tips.zh_TW: 需要計時嗎?右鍵選單能幫你設計時器,也能開碼表喔!
tips.en: Need a timer? The right-click menu can set one for you, or run a stopwatch!

tips.zh_TW: 不想錯過我們的對話?試試看「對話集中」吧!
tips.en: Don't want to miss what we say? Try "Dialogue Focus"!

tips.zh_TW: 不想讓氣泡跟著我動來動去的話,右鍵選單可以「固定氣泡位置」。
tips.en: If you don't want bubbles moving around with me, use "Pin bubble position" in the right-click menu.

tips.zh_TW: 一隻桌寵可以有好幾套外觀,研究看看「角色庫」吧!
tips.en: A pet can have several looks — go explore the Character Library!

tips.zh_TW: 現在我們不只可以「鏡像翻轉」了喔,檢查看看精靈圖編輯器吧?
tips.en: We can do more than just "Mirror flip" now — take a look in the Sprite Editor?

tips.zh_TW: 滑鼠停在對話氣泡上時,氣泡會停在原地方便你閱讀。
tips.en: Hover over a dialogue bubble and it stays put so you can read it.

tips.zh_TW: 不想被問題打擾又想看我們閒聊時,系統匣「全體行為」裡的勿擾模式能幫上你。
tips.en: Want to watch us chat without being bothered by questions? Do Not Disturb in the tray's "All Pets' Behavior" can help.

tips.zh_TW: 放鬆模式下,大家會找地方坐著休息,少動也比較省效能。
tips.en: In Relax Mode, everyone finds a spot to sit and rest — less moving, and easier on performance.

tips.zh_TW: 如果覺得我們的話太多了,可以從工具匣的「全體行為」關閉自動閒聊~
tips.en: If you think we talk too much, you can turn off auto chit-chat somewhere in the tray menu~

tips.zh_TW: 受夠滿螢幕跑的對話泡泡?全局設定的「對話集中」將帶給你另一種體驗。
tips.en: Tired of bubbles running all over the screen? "Dialogue Focus" in Global Settings offers another way.

tips.zh_TW: 跟家具一樣,對話氣泡跟聊天室窗口是可以放置在行動區外的。
tips.en: Just like furniture, dialogue bubbles and the chatroom window can be placed outside the action area.

tips.zh_TW: 我們有時候會排成一列跟著彼此走,像排隊的小鴨子一樣。
tips.en: Sometimes we line up and follow each other around, like little ducklings in a row.

tips.zh_TW: 在桌寵管理把某隻角色設成⭐最喜歡,桌寵就會特別黏著對方。
tips.en: Mark a character as ⭐ Favorite in Pet Manager, and the pet will stick close to them.

tips.zh_TW: 不想讓我們與某人互動?在好惡關係勾🚫不交互就好。
tips.en: Don't want us interacting with someone? Just check 🚫 No interaction in their relationship settings.

tips.zh_TW: 對某些性格的桌寵而言,被拖來拖去的感覺還蠻不錯的。
tips.en: For pets with certain personalities, being dragged around actually feels kind of nice.

tips.zh_TW: 好感度增減時要播什麼特效,可以在桌寵管理的「角色特效」設定。
tips.en: Which effect plays when affinity goes up or down can be set under "Character effects" in Pet Manager.

tips.zh_TW: 製造複製體固然很有趣,但最好還是決定一下誰才是本尊。
tips.en: Making clones is fun and all, but it's best to decide who the original is.

tips.zh_TW: 右鍵選單的「對戰與遊戲」有很多不錯的小遊戲,你更喜歡哪一個?
tips.en: "Battles & Games" in the right-click menu has plenty of nice minigames — which one do you like best?

tips.zh_TW: 小遊戲很有趣,但不是每個人都能接受一再的吞敗。
tips.en: Minigames are fun, but not everyone is okay with losing over and over.

tips.zh_TW: 重視戰績的話,可以決定要不要讓我們閒置時自己玩遊戲或對戰。
tips.en: If you care about your record, you can decide whether we may play games or battle on our own while idle.

tips.zh_TW: 如果讓某人接受對戰邀請很難,可以試試反過來讓對方成為主動邀請的一方!
tips.en: If getting someone to accept a battle invite is hard, try flipping it so they're the one sending the invite instead!

tips.zh_TW: 跳舞很好玩,每個人都該有跳舞動作!
tips.en: Dancing is fun — everyone should have a dance move!

tips.zh_TW: 性格會悄悄影響桌寵們玩遊戲時的反應以及日常行為。
tips.en: Personality quietly affects how pets react during games as well as their everyday behavior.

tips.zh_TW: 性格對於桌寵行為是存在影響的,這些影響你也可以自己調整喔。
tips.en: Personality does affect pet behavior, and you can adjust those effects yourself too.

tips.zh_TW: 要解鎖話題文本的對話事件,至少需要我們對你的好感度達到 30 。
tips.en: To unlock topic-line conversations, our affinity toward you needs to reach at least 30.

tips.zh_TW: 通用話題池是大家共用的話題,也能為每隻桌寵設計各自的話題。
tips.en: The generic topic pool is shared by everyone, and each pet can have its own topics designed too.

tips.zh_TW: 台詞能用的語法都收在語法字典,可以搜尋,也能一鍵插入語法。
tips.en: Every syntax you can use in lines is in the Syntax Dictionary — search it, and insert with one click.

tips.zh_TW: 在桌寵管理的文字欄位按右鍵,也能叫出語法字典。
tips.en: Right-clicking a text field in Pet Manager brings up the Syntax Dictionary too.

tips.zh_TW: 有些功能只有到了積木編輯器才能製作呼叫它們的事件。
tips.en: Some features can only be triggered by events you build in the block editor.

tips.zh_TW: 若是想看到我們更生動的一面,不妨去看看積木編輯器吧?
tips.en: Want to see a more lively side of us? Maybe take a look at the block editor.

tips.zh_TW: 你教我們的事我們都記得,要不要說出口,就看你玩不玩積木編輯器了——
tips.en: We remember everything you teach us — whether we say it out loud depends on whether you play with the block editor—

tips.zh_TW: 先在交互行為隨便寫點台詞充名單,再拿去積木編輯器細修會輕鬆很多。
tips.en: Jot down some rough lines in interaction behavior to fill the list first, then polishing them in the block editor gets much easier.

tips.zh_TW: 你可以在桌寵管理的記憶分頁導出積木編輯器需要的資料,再匯入回來。
tips.en: You can export the data the block editor needs from pet management's memory tab, then import it back in.

tips.zh_TW: 測試者面板能幫你快速試試積木做出來的效果。
tips.en: The Tester Panel lets you quickly try out what your blocks do.

tips.zh_TW: 其實不需要為每個預設動作都製作動畫,空缺的行為會用idle替代。
tips.en: You don't actually need an animation for every default action — missing ones just fall back to idle.

tips.zh_TW: 精靈圖編輯器裡的動作可以共用,也能設定循環播放幾次。
tips.en: In the Sprite Editor, actions can be shared, and you can set how many times they loop.

tips.zh_TW: 想要有更大的範圍來摸摸我們,可以到桌寵管理放大判定框。
tips.en: Want a bigger area for petting us? Enlarge the hitbox in Pet Manager.

tips.zh_TW: 眨眼和說話差分可以整張換圖,也可以只用圖層貼局部。
tips.en: Blink and talk variants can swap the whole image, or just overlay part of it with layers.

tips.zh_TW: 素材有畫爬牆動作的話,我爬牆時就不會硬轉 90 度貼上去了。
tips.en: If the art includes a climbing animation, I won't just get rotated 90 degrees when I climb walls.

tips.zh_TW: 半身立繪可以貼著螢幕底部擺,很適合比較大的角色圖。
tips.en: Half-body portraits can sit along the bottom of the screen — great for larger character art.

tips.zh_TW: 你可以在角色庫將桌寵整隻打包,便於分享給朋友……等等,啥?
tips.en: You can package up a whole pet in the character library to share with friends… wait, what?

tips.zh_TW: 你可以調整飛行模式,決定我們要一直滯空還是偶爾落地。
tips.en: You can adjust flight mode to decide whether we stay airborne all the time or land now and then.

tips.zh_TW: 家具的功能不僅僅是給桌寵們家的感覺,也能讓你妝點你的桌面。
tips.en: Furniture isn't just for giving pets a sense of home — it also lets you decorate your desktop.

tips.zh_TW: 如果你能在有空時造訪一下家具庫,我們就能有好的椅子跟床了。
tips.en: If you visit the furniture library when you have time, we could get some nice chairs and beds.

tips.zh_TW: 家具也可以做成容器,只要裡面放了東西,我們就會自己過去拿。
tips.en: Furniture can be made into containers too — put something inside and we'll go fetch it ourselves.

tips.zh_TW: 家具可以帶有效果,桌寵待在它附近時,狀態就會跟著改變。
tips.en: Furniture can carry effects — when pets stay near it, their state changes accordingly.

tips.zh_TW: 你可以在道具管理為我們製作各種用品……包括球,尤其是球。
tips.en: You can make all kinds of items for us in prop management… including balls. Especially balls.

tips.zh_TW: 如果在家具中間挖個洞,再放入聊天室……
tips.en: If you cut a hole in the middle of a piece of furniture and put the chatroom in it…

tips.zh_TW: 我們可以站在視窗上,無論能不能看見那些視窗!
tips.en: We can stand on windows, whether or not you can actually see them!

tips.zh_TW: 這個程式的作者懶得自己製作wiki,據傳有的功能她自己都沒研究透。
tips.en: This program's author is too lazy to make a wiki — rumor has it even she hasn't fully figured out some of the features.

tips.zh_TW: 作者把效能留給自訂事件跟圖像物件,所以其他地方都盡量節約。
tips.en: The author saves performance for custom events and image objects, so everything else is kept lean.
